label: Keyboard How to play opens First Flight
snapshot:
- region "Find your line.":
  - paragraph: REVEAL / LINE
  - heading "Find your line." [level=1]
  - status: Preparing your arcade. If this screen stays here, reload or open the online game.

    - link "Reload game":
      - /url: ""
    - link "Play online":

label: First Flight is ready with its actual lesson selector
snapshot:
- button "Game menu": ◩ REVEAL / LINE
- generic: FIRST FLIGHT
- button "Enter fullscreen": ⛶
- button "Game settings": Settings
- main:
  - region "Game":
    - generic: REVEALED
    - strong: 0.0%
    - emphasis: TARGET 45%
    - generic: LIVES
    - strong: ◆ ◆ ◆
    - generic: TIME
    - strong: 0:00
    - generic: SCORE
    - strong: "00000"
    - status: Fly down from the marked start to the opposite safe edge.

      - paragraph: FIRST FLIGHT / OPTIONAL TRAINING
      - heading "Close a line" [level=1]
      - paragraph: Leave the marked safe edge and reach the opposite edge.

    - button "Done reading" [disabled]
    - status: Read without starting or resuming.
    - button "Start lesson ↗" [active]
    - button "Main menu"
    - paragraph: Tap a direction to fly. Equipment controls are in How to play. Esc / P pauses.
    - strong: Ready for launch
    - generic: Close a line to reveal the picture
    - region "First Flight course":
      - heading "First Flight · Close a line" [level=2]
      - generic: Practice · no rewards
      - paragraph: Your real cuts advance these steps. Reading and course choices never move the craft.
      - generic "Lesson steps"
      - generic: Choose a lesson
      - combobox "Choose a First Flight lesson":
        - option "1. Close a line" [selected]
        - option "2. Find the empty side"
        - option "3. Bring the picture home"
      - button "Skip lesson"
      - button "Return to the game"
    - status: Start at the marked top edge. Fly down to the opposite safe edge to close a live line.
    - status
